context.body: The entry instruction expands the earlier animal command and names Noah’s righteousness in his generation.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: The LORD tells Noah to enter with his household, distinguishes clean and unclean animals, and announces seven days before forty days of rain.
observations.label: Noah’s household enters before the rain: action

observations.body: Noah obeys; his family and the animals enter as the flood approaches.
observations.label: Noah’s household enters before the rain: response

observations.body: seen your righteousness · seven pairs · two · seven days · did everything
observations.label: Words in Genesis 7:1–10

payload.posture: Read Genesis 7:1–10 as warning and the ship evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The relation between the earlier pairs and the later clean-animal numbers must be read from the narrative sequence rather than flattened into competing totals.
payload.title: Noah’s household enters before the rain
